# `execution/preview/types.ts`

Module providing shared type definitions for preview execution environments, including support for Docker Compose, Testcontainers, and local process-based previews.

---

## Interfaces

### `PreviewInfo`

Describes a running preview instance, capturing the metadata and runtime details needed to identify, connect to, and manage the preview process.

```typescript
interface PreviewInfo {
  taskId: string;
  type: "compose" | "testcontainers" | "process";
  port: number;
  host: string;
  worktreePath: string;
  startedAt: Date;
  childProcess?: ChildProcess;
  composeProject?: string;
  remoteWorktreePath?: string;
}
```

#### Members

| Member | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `taskId` | `string` | ✅ | Unique identifier for the task associated with this preview. |
| `type` | `"compose" \| "testcontainers" \| "process"` | ✅ | The execution strategy used to launch the preview. |
| `port` | `number` | ✅ | The port number on which the preview is listening. |
| `host` | `string` | ✅ | The host address where the preview is accessible. |
| `worktreePath` | `string` | ✅ | Local filesystem path to the worktree used by the preview. |
| `startedAt` | `Date` | ✅ | Timestamp indicating when the preview was started. |
| `childProcess` | `ChildProcess` | ❌ | Reference to the underlying child process, if the preview is managed as a local process. |
| `composeProject` | `string` | ❌ | The Docker Compose project name, if the preview was launched using `"compose"` type. |
| `remoteWorktreePath` | `string` | ❌ | Path to the worktree on a remote host, if the preview is running remotely. |

#### Example

```typescript
const preview: PreviewInfo = {
  taskId: "task-abc-123",
  type: "compose",
  port: 3000,
  host: "localhost",
  worktreePath: "/home/user/project/.worktrees/task-abc-123",
  startedAt: new Date(),
  composeProject: "myapp-task-abc-123",
};
```
